package.name: easyfleet_easynav_deployment
package.description: The "easynav" deployment scenario: this package's own easyfleet_core::NavigationActionServerBase subclass, driving EasyNav (easynav_system::GoalManagerClient) through a BehaviorTree.CPP tree (StartOff -> Navigate -> Finish). Owns the capability implementation itself -- how a robot's navigation capability turns waypoints and BT plugins into a running ROS action is a manufacturer/integrator choice -- reusing only easyfleet_easynav_navigation's Navigate BT.CPP plugin (loaded by path via the `bt_plugins` parameter, alongside this package's own fake StartOff/Finish plugins). easynav_gazebo_launch.yaml runs EasyNav (easynav_system system_main) configured for real navigation (costmap localizer/maps-manager/planner + regulated pure-pursuit controller), for use with a real robot or a Gazebo simulation of one -- unnamespaced by default, or namespaced via its "robot_namespace" launch argument. Also ships the example mission script built on easyfleet_mission_manager and the launch files and JSON/parameter configuration it is started with.
